items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: But he and Marion got married the year after Speedy and I did, you know?

ctx.x: Uh-huh, '45, a year before Eubie Blake, because we were like -- I don't know whether I was the best man or what. But he and Marion got married the year after Speedy and I did, you know?
Didn't Speedy also have a restaurant or something in Pittsburgh?
